packageRegistries.help: The registries every Node source of this organization installs from, for its own code and its dependencies. Each field can hold a value or a secret reference such as ${secret:npm_token}. The public npm registry needs no entry.
packageRegistries.npmHelp: A registry with a scope serves that scope's packages. The mirror serves every other package.
packageRegistries.npmNone: No npm registries. Packages come from the public npm registry.
packageRegistries.gitHelp: The hosts Node sources fetch Git code and Git dependencies from.
packageRegistries.scopeHelp: For example @acme. Leave empty for a registry with no scope.
packageRegistries.gitCredentialHelp: A token with read access to the repositories.
packageRegistries.mirrorHelp: Every package without a scope of its own is installed through this registry. An organization has one mirror.
